# Error codes

<!-- Generated by crates/castable-core/tests/fixtures.rs from ErrorCode. Do not edit; run UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test. -->

Every error Castable reports has a code. The first digit is its category, the same for every player and platform. Logs show `code` (`E403`), `error` (`forbidden`), `category` and, when the source said something, `detail`. To add a code, add one line to the `codes!` table in `crates/castable-core/src/errors.rs`; screens show the category's message until they get a specific one.

## player (1xx)

| Code | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E101 | `player_missing` | the player isn't installed or can't start |
| E102 | `player_crashed` | the player quit with an error |
| E103 | `player_unresponsive` | the player stopped answering |

## network (2xx)

| Code | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E201 | `network` | the video's server couldn't be reached, or the connection dropped |
| E202 | `timeout` | the video's server took too long to answer |

## media (4xx)

| Code | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E403 | `forbidden` | the video's server refused it (it may only play in its own app) |
| E404 | `not_found` | the video isn't there any more (the link may have expired) |
| E415 | `unsupported` | the player can't play this format |
| E422 | `decode` | the video is damaged or couldn't be decoded |

## control (6xx)

| Code | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E601 | `invalid_action` | the phone asked for something this receiver doesn't do |
| E602 | `invalid_args` | the phone sent a command with missing or bad values |
| E603 | `action_failed` | the command failed |
| E604 | `not_now` | that command doesn't apply right now (nothing is loaded, say) |
| E605 | `seek_not_supported` | this video can't be seeked (a live stream) |
| E606 | `seek_out_of_range` | the seek goes past the end of the video |
| E607 | `mime_not_accepted` | the receiver doesn't accept this kind of media |
| E608 | `invalid_instance` | the phone addressed a player this receiver doesn't have |

## config (7xx)

| Code | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E701 | `settings_invalid` | the settings file couldn't be read |
| E702 | `players_file_invalid` | a players.toml entry is wrong |
| E703 | `player_unknown` | there's no player with that name |
| E704 | `player_not_for_this_os` | that player doesn't run on this computer's OS |
| E705 | `bad_argument` | a command-line argument is wrong |

## system (8xx)

| Code | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E801 | `port_in_use` | the port is already in use by another program |
| E802 | `no_network` | this computer has no network that phones can reach |
| E803 | `io` | a file or folder couldn't be read or written |

## unknown (9xx)

| Code | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E999 | `unknown` | something went wrong |
